title: Vivaldi 8.0
summary: Vivaldi 8.0 is a major desktop browser release from the privacy-focused browser company, bringing new features, performance improvements, and enhanced customization options to their Chromium-based browser. The update continues Vivaldi's tradition of offering a feature-rich alternative to mainstream browsers with deep user control.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative browser for users seeking more privacy, customization, and built-in productivity features than what mainstream browsers offer.
why_valuable: Vivaldi 8.0 delivers enhanced privacy controls, tab management, and user customization that empowers users who want more control over their browsing experience without relying on browser extensions.
